head: working-tree
subject: RDS regex path, header-hash and host-path rewrites
change: RouteAction.regex_rewrite (field 32), HashPolicy.Header.regex_rewrite and RouteAction.host_rewrite_path_regex (field 35) now decode RegexMatchAndSubstitute, compile the pattern with the bounded xDS safe-regex parser, validate RE2-style \0..\9 substitution references, and apply leftmost-first global replacement. Path rewrites run while copying owned request inputs; header hash rewrites transform the joined header value before XXH64; host path rewrites evaluate the path with query and fragment removed and use the result as :authority. Greedy and lazy quantifiers keep their priority semantics. Replacement runs on an explicit backtracking stack with hard step, choice and capture-trail budgets; the selector precomputes exact output lengths so the existing single-allocation request-input copy and max_header_bytes checks remain unchanged.

unit: src/grpc/xds/routing/regex/replace_tests.zig covers numbered groups, global replacement, lazy quantifiers, inline case folding, \0 and \\, unmatched groups, Unicode captures, unknown group references and the backtracking budget.

src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS applies regex rewrites and rejects format rewrites' decodes a route with ^/service/([^/]+)(/.*)$ -> \2/instance/\1, asserts the selected output length and rewritten path, and rejects empty rewrites, unknown capture references, malformed patterns and format path_rewrite.
src/grpc/channel/shared/request_inputs_tests.zig applies the selected regex rewrite through the production owned-input copy and verifies the rewritten path, authority and header mutation layout.
src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS applies header hash regex rewrites' decodes a terminal HashPolicy.Header with ^tenant-(\d+)$ -> \1 and asserts the selected hash is XXH64 of the rewritten value.
src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS applies host rewrite path regex' decodes host_rewrite_path_regex, strips query and fragment, and asserts the selected authority rewrite and output length.

src/grpc/channel/shared/request_inputs_tests.zig 'shared request inputs apply host rewrite path regex' verifies the production owned-input copy writes the rewritten authority into the same allocation as the path and header mutations.

request_inputs.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='shared request inputs' --summary all

full_library.note: The full library suite passed after the header hash rewrite. For this host-path slice, the focused RDS (181/181) and request-input (158/158) gates pass; a full-suite rerun was still running under heavy host load when this evidence was recorded.

notes: Route path and header-hash regex rewriting are covered by native tests and 1,333 independent RE2 WASM replacement vectors. path_rewrite_policy format rewrites, host_rewrite_path_regex and non-router HTTP filters remain open.
